name: City Life
summary: A free open-world game set in San Cordova, a fictional sun-soaked coastal city inspired by Miami. Built from scratch in Unreal Engine 5.8.
description: PROJECT: CITY LIFE is an open-world game by MOONCREST GROUP. It takes place in San Cordova, a fictional coastal city in the spirit of Miami and South Florida, with its own streets and buildings. The game is being built from scratch in Unreal Engine 5.8 and is planned to be free to play.

sections.title: San Cordova.
sections.body:
San Cordova is the fictional coastal city at the heart of PROJECT: CITY LIFE, inspired by Miami and South Florida.

It is meant to feel instantly recognisable as Miami, but it is not a copy: its streets, buildings and layout are designed freely for the game.

More about the city and what you will do there will be revealed as development continues.
